name: Camisa at Pantalon
description: Plain camisa and dark trousers, hand-stitched.

name: Collarless Barong
description: Rough cloth, worn by a man who works land, not a uniform.

name: Katipunan Headband
description: A woven headband worn into battle by rank-and-file Katipuneros.

name: Reinforced Camisa
description: A reinforced camisa cut for movement rather than farm work.

name: Baro't Saya
description: Hand-woven, slightly too large for the frame it's on.

name: Soldier's Cotton Shirt
description: What replaces the baro't saya once Sandra joins Luna's army at Calumpit.

name: Tiradores' Field Wear
description: Militia dress worn by the mixed Ilocano infantry and Sharpshooters.

name: Officer's Jacket
description: Antonio Luna's uniform — immaculate, even now, even in retreat.

name: Polished Boots
description: Polished boots that complete Luna's field dress.

name: ROTC Uniform
description: A uniform that almost fits — issued at induction, two weeks before Bataan.

name: POW Rags
description: What's left of a uniform after the Death March and Camp O'Donnell.
note: Force-equipped during the Death March. Cannot be unequipped manually.

name: Guerrilla Fatigues
description: Rifles, bolos, and improvised gear worn by Pajota's men at Cabanatuan.

name: Barrio Alias Attire
description: Plain, deliberately unremarkable clothing — part of moving through the occupation as a ghost.

name: Anting-Anting
description: A folk amulet believed to turn aside blade and bullet alike.
note: HIT -3%. Not sourced from the script — included per design note.
